headline: Largan Precision, Lens Technology and 4 Others Placed Under Disposition from 9/2; Largan and 45 Others on Attention List - Liberty Finance
summary: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taipei Exchange placed six listed and OTC stocks, including Largan Precision and Foxsemicon, under disposition from September 2. Largan and 45 others are on the attention list.
why: Disposition measures are exchange trading restrictions applied to stocks, which constrain trading and can raise volatility and liquidity risk for affected shareholders.
